payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance metrics comparing NUS and ABUS, allowing for a clear quantification of their performance differences.

claims.text: The NUS outperformed the ABUS with a success rate of 93.4% compared to 90.0% for the ABUS.
The average reward for the NUS was 13.8, while for the ABUS it was 13.3.
In cross-model evaluation, the NUS achieved a success rate of 94.0% when tested on the ABUS, while the ABUS achieved only 45.5% when tested on the NUS.
